definitions.explanation: The period or state following someone's death. Often used as a temporal modifier.

examples.japanese: {死後|しご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{信|しん}じる→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{死後|しご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: His works were appreciated after his death.

examples.japanese: {死後|しご}⟦{数十年|すうじゅうねん}→数十年：30639_suujuunen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経|た}って→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{未発表|みはっぴょう}→未発表：24845_mihappyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原稿|げんこう}→原稿：00064_genkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Decades after the author's death, an unpublished manuscript was discovered.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{死|し}→死：13248_shi⟧ (death) + ⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧ (after). Functions both as a noun and as an adverbial modifier. Commonly used in discussions of legacy, afterlife, inheritance, and posthumous recognition.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {死後|しご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧: the afterlife; the world after death
- {死後|しご}⟦{硬直|こうちょく}→硬直：09012_kouchoku⟧: rigor mortis
- {死後|しご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出版|しゅっぱん}→出版：03222_shuppan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧: published posthumously

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{生前|せいぜん}→生前：16391_seizen⟧: during one's lifetime — the temporal opposite of {死後|しご}
- {遺|い}: prefix meaning "left behind by the deceased" (e.g., {遺作|いさく} posthumous work, {遺品|いひん} belongings of the deceased)
- ⟦{死語|しご}→死語：17170_shigo⟧: dead language; obsolete word — a homophone with a completely different meaning
